steps.title: Slide 1: Cover
steps.say: Prowler Warden is the agent that keeps your cloud secure and compliant, autonomously.

steps.title: Slide 2: Problem and solution
steps.say: Compliance is a snapshot. Scans go stale, console fixes never reach Terraform so the next apply undoes them, and every finding looks equally urgent. Warden makes Prowler continuous: real-time checks, a decision on what is actually being used, a fix in AWS and in code, and proof. One runtime switch picks self-fix or human PR review.

steps.title: Slide 3: Architecture
steps.say: CloudTrail events reach Prowler in seconds through EventBridge, and each risky one triggers a targeted Prowler check. ClickHouse stores every result. A Claude agent decides. Actions are real: an AWS fix, a Semgrep-gated PR, a Slack alert from an agent hosted on Guild.ai, and a public status page.

steps.title: Dashboard: Overview
steps.say: Real account, CIS 5.0: 28.8 percent. The simulator shows the path: self-fix gets 34.6, pull requests to code 84.6, and only people can finish the last 15 percent, like root MFA.

steps.title: Dashboard: Fix simulator
steps.say: (the demo opens SSH to the internet on a test group right now)

steps.title: Dashboard: Cost and signals
steps.say: Compliance says what is misconfigured. Cost says what is being used. EC2 spend is 13x its baseline, so open-to-internet findings in EC2 now rank as likely being used.

steps.title: Dashboard: Live events
steps.say: This is Prowler real-time. I just opened SSH to the internet on a test group. The API call reaches Prowler through EventBridge in seconds.

steps.title: Dashboard: Detections
steps.say: Prowler ran a targeted check on that exact resource and confirmed the violation.

steps.title: Dashboard: Remediation
steps.say: Self-fix mode closed the port in AWS and Prowler verified it. It also opened a pull request that removes the same rule from Terraform, so the next apply cannot reopen it. (click the PR link)

steps.title: Dashboard: Agent actions
steps.say: (point at the AWS fix and the PR in the action log)

steps.title: Switch to the Slack tab
steps.say: The Guild.ai agent posted the alert to Slack.

steps.title: Switch to the status page tab
steps.say: And Warden published a redacted status page with a SHA-256 over the evidence, so anyone can verify it was not edited.

steps.title: Dashboard: close
steps.say: Three sponsor tools in the loop: ClickHouse, Guild.ai and Semgrep. Click Revert to undo, or Reset demo to run it again.
